text: 上交所：本周对53起拉抬打压、虚假申报等证券异常交易行为采取了自律监管措施，对龙版传媒等波动幅度较大的股票进行重点监控，对32起上市公司重大事项等进行专项核查，向证监会上报涉嫌违法违规案件线索1起。
text_en: Shanghai Stock Exchange: This week, the Exchange took self-regulatory measures against 53 cases of abnormal securities trading such as ramping up and suppressing and false declarations, conducted key monitoring of stocks with relatively large fluctuations such as Longban Media, carried out special verification on 32 major matters of listed companies, and reported 1 clue on a suspected illegal and non-compliant case to the CSRC.
